message:
The other day, we found ourselves in the middle of a sudden thunderstorm. As the skies darkened, we quickly gathered our go-bags and the essentials — water, snacks, important documents — knowing it was a good chance to check our plans. Instead of feeling rushed or anxious, we turned it into a little cozy event. We set up a blanket fort in the living room, lit some candles, and played our favorite board games while listening to the rain. 

It was a perfect reminder that being prepared doesn’t have to be stressful; it can be an opportunity to connect and create memories together. How do you make preparedness a little brighter in your home? ☔
